{{Quote|I understand the general in command of the ''Executor''{{'s}} ground forces resigned suddenly a month ago.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>}}
A '''general''' preceded [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] as the commanding officer of the ground forces of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. By late [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] understood it, this general had suddenly resigned his command. Thrawn suggested Veers to Vader as this general's replacement.
